name: Best [AI Tool] for Every Task
description: A fast talking-head list where the creator names a use-case then the AI tool for it, and that tool's app icon pops in below the chin with the tool's own name picked out in yellow in the caption line. Repeats for many task→tool pairs, then ends on a follow CTA with a Follow button.

slots.name: hookClip
slots.instructions: Sit centered, eye-level, plain interview background. Open cold with your first use-case then the tool, phrased with a marker word, e.g. 'Writing emails? I use Claude.' Keep it snappy — under 2 seconds — and dive straight in with no intro.

slots.name: hookIcon
slots.instructions: Square app icon / logo of the tool you name here, on transparent or its native background, so it can pop below your chin.

slots.name: clip2
slots.instructions: State your second use-case then the tool with a marker word, e.g. 'Brainstorming ideas, I use ChatGPT.' Keep the same cadence as item one.

slots.name: icon2
slots.instructions: Square app icon / logo of the tool named in this line.

slots.instructions: State your third use-case then the tool with a marker word, e.g. 'Deep research, I use Perplexity.'

slots.name: icon3

slots.name: ctaClip
slots.instructions: Close with a direct ask, gesturing toward the button: 'Follow [YourHandle] for daily AI tips.' Say your handle immediately after the word 'Follow'.

slots.name: button
slots.instructions: Optional: a blue rounded 'Follow' button graphic (like the native app button) to sit under the caption; leave blank to use the built-in one.
